item.title: Paramount Skydance Launches Hostile $30-Per-Share Bid for Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Paramount Skydance has initiated a hostile takeover attempt of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), according to CNBC.

item.title: IBM to Acquire Confluent for $11 Billion
item.description: IBM announced it will acquire Confluent in a $11 billion all-cash deal, paying $31 per share for the real-time data streaming company.

item.title: Trump to Announce $12 Billion Farm Aid Package Amid Tariff-Driven Strain
item.description: President Donald Trump plans to unveil a $12 billion aid package for U.S. farmers struggling with rising costs and reduced crop sales.

item.title: Dalio Says UAE and Saudi Arabia are Emerging as Major Global A.I. Hubs
item.description: The Middle East, led by UAE and Saudi Arabia, is rapidly becoming a global AI powerhouse with massive sovereign-wealth funding and top-tier tech partnerships.

item.title: Musk Attacks EU After X Fined $140 Million for DSA Violations
item.description: Elon Musk criticized the European Union after it fined X $140 million for misleading blue-checkmark practices and insufficient transparency in its advertising.

item.title: ‘Five Nights at Freddy’s 2’ Surges to No. 1 With $63 Million Opening Weekend
item.description: Universal’s “Five Nights at Freddy’s 2” topped the weekend box office with an estimated $63 million, surpassing expectations overtaking Disney’s “Zootopia 2".

item.title: What to know about changes to Disney parks’ disability policies
item.description: Disney's changes to a program for disabled visitors are facing challenges in federal court and through a shareholder proposal. The Disability Access Service program, which allows disabled visitors to skip long lines, was overhauled last year. Disney now mostly limits the program to those with developmental disabilities like autism who have difficulty waiting in lines. The changes have sparked criticism from some disability advocates. item.title: Trump says Netflix deal to buy Warner Bros. ‘could be a problem’ because of size of market share
item.description: President Donald Trump says a deal struck by Netflix last week to buy Warner Bros. Discovery “could be a problem” because of the size of the combined market share. The Republican president says he will be involved in the decision about whether federal regulators should approve the deal. Trump commented Sunday when he was asked about the deal as he walked the red carpet at the Kennedy Center Honors. item.title: Swing district Republicans brace for political fallout if health care subsidies expire
item.description: House Republicans in key battleground districts are working to contain the political fallout expected when thousands of their constituents face higher bills for health insurance coverage obtained through the Affordable Care Act. item.description: U.S. sports betting is booming as NFL and college football fuel massive activity. BetMGM CEO Adam Greenblatt breaks down trends, growth, and what’s next.
